content: RESULT (acto-fixer, commit 82e0257): the build-crate TString def is now emitted by thermite-lower/src/l1.rs::emit_string_runtime_l1, wired into lower_l1 after the combinator defs. Resolution = option (b) (the L1 BUILD-lowering emits it, mirroring the L3 lower.rs::emit_string_wrapper but as plain Rust — no vstd/Seq/spec). It emits 'struct TString { data: Vec<u8> }' (matching the wrappers' super::TString { data } construction) + 'use TString as String;' (so a body's String::new() resolves to TString, 07-strings.md REQ-4) + the new/len/byte_at/concat/slice surface (no-OOB/bounded checks via the always-active thermite_check!), gated on program_uses_string_l1 (non-String corpus byte-unaffected). BEFORE: forge build print_demo --entry greet -> E0425 cannot find type TString (super + this scope). AFTER: rustc exit 0; greet()=0 (write wrapper); read_line reads stdin -> getit()=TString{data:[104,101,...]}, exit 0.
